UC-1296.en: Not sent, because you stopped it.
UC-1296.note: The composer's working line when the host says a message never started because it was stopped (#1314: TurnEnded.cause stopped). The words are back in the box. Replaces UC-1147's wording where the host gives the cause; UC-1147 stays for this window's own Stop with no cause.

UC-1297.en: Not sent: you sent a newer message first.
UC-1297.note: The composer's working line when a message never started because a newer one was sent now first (#1314: cause sent_now, status not_sent). The words are back in the box. New.

UC-1298.en: Not sent, because the answer it was for stopped.
UC-1298.note: The composer's working line when a message never started because the answer it was sent into stopped (#1314: cause not_sent, status not_sent). The words are back in the box. New.

UC-1299.en: This waits because Clauseo was updating. It goes once Clauseo is ready.
UC-1299.note: The queue's line under its head while a queued message is the host's copy of one held for an update (#1314: copy_of.cause update on the copy; the original is hidden). The installing line (queue_held_reason update) takes its place while the update installs. New.

UC-1247.en: This waits because {agent} needed you to sign in. It goes once you're signed in.
UC-1247.note: The queue's line while a queued message is the host's copy of one held for the agent's sign-in (#1314: copy_of.cause sign_in); {agent} is Claude or ChatGPT. Same shape as UC-1299. New.
